CNC machining RFQ checklist

Five essential requirements

Download order acceptance checklist

A buyer worksheet for drawing revision, critical features, documents and shipping requirements. This is not an inspection report.

Define how the part will be accepted
Send a consistent drawing package

Include a 3D model, such as STEP, and a 2D drawing when dimensions, fits or surface requirements are not fully defined in the model. Label the part number, units and drawing revision. If the files disagree, identify which document controls before requesting a quotation.

For multi-axis parts, include the overall envelope, stock dimensions and part weight where known so tool access and setup can be reviewed.

Only have a sample?

For an existing sample without a drawing, explain what is known and ask what additional measurement or design work would be needed. A sample alone cannot establish hidden material or treatment requirements.

Mark the dimensions used for acceptance

Identify mating bores and shaft fits on the drawing, with their datums and tolerances. Mark sealing faces, threads and any other critical features too. State whether dimensions apply before or after finishing.

If you need a particular inspection record, send the format or an example with your inquiry. Agree on inspection and documentation requirements before ordering, and ask LZZ to confirm the measurement method, instrument range, calibration evidence and availability of any project-specific records required for your part.

Inspection & documentation requirements
Specify the material and final surface
Material requirements

State the exact alloy or polymer grade, or the functional requirement if selection is still open. Include any required material documentation and whether substitutes may be considered.

Finish and surface requirements

Provide the finish specification, appearance, cosmetic faces, masking and edge conditions. Include any customer or industry standards and certificates required for this part or program. State the required standard, revision and scope.

A material or capability category on this site does not establish industry certification or application compliance. The material and finish checklist explains the decisions behind these fields.

What drawing review returns

Our quotation brings together the proposed process, material, finishing, order quantity, inspection documents, production schedule and shipping basis. Where geometry or acceptance requirements need clarification, we identify the open points before you approve production.

Related part examples

Ready to prepare the email?

If your project needs an NDA or a controlled transfer method, contact LZZ before sending restricted files. This website does not automatically create an NDA.

Prepare the draft on the inquiry page.
